2009 Results Highlights
Fiscal Year Ended March 31,, 2009

• Strong subscriber growth
−30.6% y-o-y growth from 10.23 million to 13.36 million subscribers

−MMarkket shhare off 7799%%
• Launch of several key initiatives to position Safaricom for future success

−Launch of Data Services (3G & Wimax)
−Jibambie Promotion
−Launch of the Jambo Contact Centre

• M-PESA - a runaway success story
−6.18 million registered users as of March 2009 (2.08 million March 08)

−Ksh 17.1bn transferred person to person in March 2009 (Ksh. 3.0 bn March 08)
−Additional services continue to be launched
